units: CNY per share unless otherwise stated

rows.share_basis: disclosed-dilution shares: legal shares less treasury shares plus remaining convertible conversion shares plus the approved maximum seventh employee share-plan transfer; no unsupported effective-interest add-back is used, while employee-plan cash proceeds are added to equity value
rows.market_cap_basis: current legal shares of 3,821,562,147 multiplied by the CNY15.06 intraday price
rows.disclosed_dilution_capitalization_basis: disclosed-dilution shares of 3,880,694,188.9535 multiplied by the CNY15.06 intraday price; this is a capital-structure sensitivity, not current quoted market capitalization
rows.method: cycle-adjusted disclosed-dilution PE-equity-value bridge using reported-basis profit without unsupported convertible effective-interest add-back, plus employee-plan cash proceeds and share-normalized fundamental, market and external Street anchors
rows.market_anchor_basis: rounded five-session VWAP through 2026-07-21 (CNY14.6555) and current intraday price (CNY15.06) midpoint
rows.street_anchor_basis: Guosen target midpoint CNY17.05 multiplied by Guosen forecast shares 3.603bn, plus CNY1.8746bn maximum employee-plan cash proceeds, divided by house disclosed-dilution shares 3.88069bn
rows.action: Neutral / watch; do not chase, require H2 earnings and cash-flow validation
rows.evidence_quality: official filings for shares and reported financials; full original broker PDF for Street anchor; live AStock quote; scenario assumptions are AStock house estimates

quarterly_profit_bridge_100mn_cny.boundary: Q3E and Q4E are house timing assumptions, not company guidance; do not mechanically annualize Q3

share_reconciliation.coupon_and_effective_interest_treatment: no profit add-back in primary valuation because bond effective-interest amortization and tax effect are not separately disclosed; this is intentionally conservative

share_reconciliation.timing_note: treasury shares are from the 2026-06-12 distribution register while legal shares and bond balance are at 2026-06-30; the employee plan is approved but the final subscription and transfer quantity are uncertain; remaining treasury-share use is not confirmed
